DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Paragraph Three Takes the Stand

STS-HS9-L4-1400P-HSELA910-MKT-IMR-01 • HS English Grade 9 • Organizing Ideas and Making Connections in Informative Writing
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
In a real courtroom a lawyer cannot hand the judge a fact and sit down. She has to say what the fact proves and how it ties to everything the jury already heard. Amina, Farid, and Yulia are running that same test on an essay about three families who traveled a long way to get here. Every paragraph is an exhibit, and every exhibit needs a link that says why it belongs.
Exhibit B is the suitcase. What sentence would you say to connect the suitcase to the main idea of the essay?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Amina doing?
Look at the picture. Justify what Amina is doing with evidence you can see, add one exact detail about what her hand is aimed at, then say what this tells you about the decision the group is trying to reach.
2
What is Farid holding?
Look at the picture. Justify what Farid is holding with evidence you can see, add one exact detail that hangs from it, then say what this tells you about the decision the group is trying to reach.
3
What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Justify what the teacher is doing with evidence you can see, add one exact detail about the machine under her hands, then say what this tells you about the decision the group is trying to reach.
4
What kind of place is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Justify what kind of place this is with evidence you can see, add one more thing in the room that proves your answer, then say what this tells you about the decision the group is trying to reach.
5
Tell me about the board on the easel.
Look at the picture. Justify what is on the big white board with evidence you can see, add one exact word printed on the board, then say what this tells you about the decision the group is trying to reach.
6
What is Yulia wearing?
Look at the picture. Justify what Yulia is wearing with evidence you can see, add one exact color word for it, then say what this tells you about the decision the group is trying to reach.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
Content alignment: CCSS W.9-10.2 — Write informative and explanatory texts, organizing complex ideas and making connections. ELD (Speaking — official ELPAC “Talk About a Scene”): PI.A.1, PII.B.3, PII.B.4, PII.B.5.
